name: Hillstone Networks Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hillstone Networks Co.,Ltd. provides an infrastructure protection solutions to enterprises and service providers. The company provides edge protection solutions; cloud protection and security management solutions; breach protection solutions; and application delivery controller solution, as well as technical support and training services. It offers zero-trust network access; extended detection and response; cloud workload protection; secure SD-wan; network detection and response; and micro-segmentation for cloud data centers solutions. In addition, the company provides border security, cloud security, intranet security, data security, business security, intelligent security operation, security service, and security operation and maintenance services. The company serves safeguarding telcos and ISPs; fortifying financial services; enhancing security in higher education; and defending government agencies industries. Hillstone Networks Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
